headline: Affle 3i Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Affle 3i Limited has informed the Exchange that Affle 3iL Ltd. ( Affle ), wholly owned step down subsidiary of the Company has entered into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Perion Network Ltd., Israel.
